## What changes

`main`'s `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)` has been red on every run that runs it since `69fa23d6` (#25956), on one assertion of the authz blind-spot census:

```
control "handleI18nRequest" moved in packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts: expected 4 to be 3
```

The census is a measurement pin, so the fourth occurrence was read before it was recorded. One file changes: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, the `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` row. The `handleI18nRequest` control goes from 3 to 4, and the row's comment names the fourth occurrence and why reach is unchanged. No other row, no total and no derivation rule moves.

## The fourth occurrence, read

`packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` at `05f7758f` holds `handleI18nRequest` four times:

| line | what it is | since |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 20 | file docblock, a `{@link handleI18nRequest}` | before |
| 73 | `TRANSLATIONS_CACHE_CONTROL`'s docblock, `(see the floor in {@link handleI18nRequest})` | `69fa23d6` |
| 150 | the `DomainRoute` call site in `createI18nDomain` | before |
| 155 | `export async function handleI18nRequest(` | before |

`69fa23d6` (the translations validator, Part of #25785) added three module-private helpers to that file (`requestHeader`, `ifNoneMatchHits`, `translationsAnswer`) and the one constant. None of them is an `export async function handle*Request` entry point, it added no `DomainRoute` prefix, and it added no `shouldDenyAnonymous(` call. The anonymous floor is still the handler's first statement. So the row's population, reach and gate control are unchanged at 1 / 1 / 1, and the row's own population and reach test stayed green on `main` the whole time. The only reading that moved is the handler-name control, by a docblock link. This is a count change, not a census row change, and nothing here needs a new probe.

## Sweep of the rest of the census

- At this branch's base `05f7758f` the census file reads `1 failed | 46 passed` (the same i18n assertion, nothing else), and with this change `47 passed`. So no other control, row, total or probe-table reading has moved since `69fa23d6` or with any later merge up to `05f7758f`.
- `origin/main` has since moved to `a4eae064` (4 commits). In the census-read source directories they touch only two test files (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin.test.ts`), and the census reads neither, so the reading holds there too.

PR and merge-group CI never run the dogfood legs, so this PR's checks cannot show the fix. The card's acceptance is read on `main` after landing: the first push run that runs `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)`, and the next scheduled run. Both run ids will be reported on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- A docblock that links the handler by name moves this control, and so do the nine sibling domain rows, each of which counts its own handler's name by substring. That is the pin doing its job: it makes whoever touches the file re-read the row. It is also why PR CI, which skips the dogfood legs, merged the change green. Making PR or merge-group CI run them is out of scope here. #24073 and #22653 ruled on that.
